mapper.select: select aa.* from( SELECT a.seq, a.delNy, a.codegroupcode, a.title, b.name, a.code, a.codename, a.number, a.codegroup_seq FROM code a JOIN codegroup b ON b.seq = a.codegroup_seq WHERE 1=1 AND a.delNy = 0 ORDER BY seq DESC ) aa limit #{rowNumToShow} offset #{startRnumForMysql}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code( delNy, codegroupcode, title, code, codename, number, codegroup_seq )VALUES( #{delNy}, #{codegroupcode}, #{title}, #{code}, #{codename}, #{number}, #{codegroup_seq} )
